cohort: 200 pregnant women beyond 32 weeks' gestation were recruited at a tertiary hospital near Israel's northern border during the 2024 Iron Swords War.
finding: Higher perceived stress, greater intolerance of uncertainty, and nulliparity significantly predicted increased fear of childbirth, which was also found to predict emergent cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Fear of childbirth was found to predict emergent cesarean delivery.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy (beyond 32 weeks' gestation) amid the 2024 Iron Swords War.
